description: This Java class implements a policy evaluation algorithm based on a trie-enabled enforcer. It provides methods for checking permissions, extracting subject IDs and subjects with certain permissions, and building JSON views based on policies and authorization contexts. It mainly delegates its logic to a TrieBasedPolicyEnforcer instance.

classes.name: TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithm
classes.description: Implements a policy algorithm that delegates permission checks and subject retrieval to a trie-based enforcer, enabling efficient policy enforcement based on resource keys and permissions.

methods.name: TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithm
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the algorithm with a specific policy, creating a new trie-based enforcer instance.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the given resource and authorization context grant unrestricted permissions.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns IDs of subjects that have permission for a given resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subject entities with specific permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Obtains IDs of subjects with partial permission rights for a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subjects with partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Determines if partial permissions exist for a given resource and context.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Constructs a JSON representation of the resource view based on given fields, context, and permissions.
